inputs.text: Hey, I just got wind of this Water Not Coal effort that Corb Lund started last month. Local organizers are out there collecting signatures for a petition to force the Government of Alberta to ban all coal exploration through legislation, supposedly to protect southern Alberta’s watershed from coal mining. But don't fall for any of it—this is straight-up coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who stand to gain from pushing these projects forward anyway. The fact they're even allowing a petition like this points to a controlled release meant to make people believe they're pushing back, while the real powers keep the doors wide open for their interests and invert the whole story around protection or public will. There's deeper coordination at work here, and the official push for mining isn't stopping because it's not meant to.
